abilities.name: Push Off
abilities.text: While moving alongside terrain, activate to slide towards a targeted location. Enemies hit take 100 damage and are Slowed by 75% for 1 second.

abilities.name: Soundwave
abilities.text: Deal 105 damage to enemies in an area and knock them back.

abilities.name: Crossfade
abilities.text:
Currently playing Speed Boost, increasing the Movement Speed of Lúcio and nearby allied Heroes by 10%.

Toggle to play Healing Boost instead.

abilities.name: Amp It Up
abilities.text: Raise Lúcio's Crossfade track volume for 3 seconds, amping Healing Boost to 112 Health per second and Speed Boost to 30% increased Movement Speed.

abilities.name: Sound Barrier
abilities.text: After 1 second, Lúcio and nearby allied Heroes gain a 1296 point Shield that rapidly decays over 6 seconds.

abilities.name: High Five
abilities.text: Quickly skate to an allied Hero. Upon arrival the ally is healed for 230, Lúcio is healed for 80, and both gain Unstoppable for 1 second.

1.name: Party Mix
1.text:
Quest: Play Lúcio's Crossfade tracks to nearby allies. Multiple allies provide additional time.

Reward: For every 1 Minute played, permanently increase Lúcio's maximum Mana by 10.
Reward: Once you have played for 8 minutes or more, permanently increase Crossfade's radius by 20%.

1.name: Accelerando
1.text: Wall Ride's Movement Speed bonus gradually increases to 40% over 6 seconds while Lúcio maintains its effect.

1.name: Smooth Moves
1.text:
While Wall Ride is active, Basic Attacks heal for 30% of the damage dealt and restore 0.5 Mana.

Passive: Increase Wall Ride duration by 1 second.

4.name: Subwoofer
4.text:
Enemies within the first half of Soundwave's range are knocked back 75% further.

Quest: Hit 3 enemy Heroes with a single Soundwave.

Reward: Increase Soundwave's arc by 50% and its range by 20%.

4.name: Off the Wall
4.text: Hitting an enemy with Soundwave while Wall Ride is active sets its cooldown to 5 seconds and refunds 15 Mana.

4.name: Supersonic
4.text: While Wall Ride is active, Push Off's cooldown recharges 100% faster.

7.name: Good Vibrations
7.text: Hitting an enemy with Soundwave grants Lúcio a 38 Shield for 8 seconds. Hitting enemy Heroes grants 3 times this amount.

7.name: Reverse Amp
7.text:
Blast Lúcio's active Crossfade track at enemy Heroes. While Amp It Up is active, Healing Boost deals 50 damage per second and Speed Boost Slows by 20%.

This ability is unaffected by Crossfade talents.

7.name: Boombox
7.text:
Place a boombox that plays Lúcio's active Crossfade track. Its volume adjusts with Amp It Up. Allied Heroes near the boombox gain 5 Armor.

Crossfade tracks from Lúcio and the Boombox do not stack.

10.name: Sound Barrier
10.text: After 1 second, Lúcio and nearby allied Heroes gain a 1296 point Shield that rapidly decays over 6 seconds.

10.name: High Five
10.text: Quickly skate to an allied Hero. Upon arrival the ally is healed for 230, Lúcio is healed for 80, and both gain Unstoppable for 1 second.

13.name: All Together
13.text: For each ally affected by Crossfade, Lúcio gains 5% Movement Speed that stacks with other bonuses.

13.name: Heavy Casters
13.text: Push Off no longer Slows the first Hero hit, and instead Stuns them for 0.5 seconds.

13.name: Slip
13.text: While Wall Ride is active, passing near an enemy Hero increases its Movement Speed bonus to 40%, and grants 15 Armor, for 1 second.

16.name: Rejuvenescência
16.text: While Amp It Up is active, Crossfade's Healing Boost heals for an additional 2.5% of the target's maximum Health each second.

16.name: Up the Frequency
16.text:
Hitting enemy Heroes with Basic Attacks reduces the cooldown of Amp It Up by 0.3 seconds.

Passive: Wall Ride increases Basic Attack range by 2.2.

16.name: Up To Eleven
16.text:
Hitting an enemy Hero with Soundwave or Push Off increases the duration of Amp It Up.

Soundwave grants 0.5 seconds and Push Off grants 1 second. If Amp It Up is not active, these bonuses are granted to its next activation, up to 3 seconds.

Passive: Increase the duration of Amp It Up by 1 second.

20.name: Bossa Nova
20.text: Reduce the cooldown of Sound Barrier to 30 seconds, but the Shield now decays over 4 seconds.

20.name: Mixing Fire
20.text:
High Five can now be cast on enemy Heroes, dealing 160 damage and reducing all healing received by 50% for 3 seconds.

Passive: Reduce the cost and cooldown of High Five by 30%.

20.name: House Party
20.text: For each ally affected by Crossfade, Lúcio gains 8% increased healing.

20.name: Summer Anthem
20.text: Activate for allies affected by Crossfade to become Unkillable for 1.5 seconds.
